description: 한국에너지공단_건축물 에너지 효율등급 정보 [buildings] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국에너지공단. 이 제도는 건축물의 에너지 낭비를 줄이고, 에너지 성능에 대한 객관적인 정보를 시장에 제공함으로써 건물의 가치를 높이며, 궁극적으로 국가적인 에너지 절약과 온실가스 배출량 감축에 기여하는. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국에너지공단. Its tags are 인증제도, 에너지효율등급, 효율등급, 1+++, 7등급. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
